App.Title: Switch CFW Wizard
App.Subtitle: Downloads the latest components and generates config files from your choices
App.Notice: 本软件免费分享，请勿用于商业用途。by：念若安止
App.Logs.Hint: The full log of this session is written to {0} (every button click and every text change; one file per day, the newest 10 kept). Send that file when reporting a problem.
App.OutputContent.Full.Desc: Also merge the extracted component files into out, producing a folder ready to copy to the SD card root. On by default; if you turn it off, out holds only config files and payloads, so you must copy the components to the SD card yourself or the console will not boot.
App.OutputContent.Payloads: Place payload files in their proper folders
App.OutputContent.Payloads.Desc: Atmosphere's fusee.bin → bootloader/payloads/ (where hekate's payload menu reads from); Hekate's payload → root payload.bin (for RCM injection) and bootloader/update.bin (for hekate self-update). With 8 GB RAM support enabled, the 8 GB payload is used.
App.Framework.BootDat.Desc: The SX GEAR boot file. It is no longer bundled: once checked, pressing Start downloads it from the boot.dat address in advanced settings and places it in the out root. Unchecked by default; the download progress is shown below.
Component.Atmosphere.Name: Atmosphere
Component.Atmosphere.Desc: The custom firmware itself. Downloads the latest zip and fusee.bin into download/Atmosphere.
Component.Hekate.Name: Hekate
Component.Hekate.Desc: Bootloader and Nyx. Downloads the latest zip and payload into download/Hekate; the ram8GB payload is used automatically when 8 GB RAM is enabled.
Component.Ultrahand.Name: Ultrahand
Component.Ultrahand.Desc: Overlay menu bundle (Ultrahand-Overlay + ovl-sysmodules + nx-ovlloader); the three are installed together.
Component.SysPatch.Name: Sys-patch
Component.SysPatch.Desc: Boot-time signature patch sysmodule, replacing classic sigpatches. Downloads into download/Sys-patch.
Component.SysPatch.ForcedHint: Force-enabled because serial blanking is selected: blanking invalidates the console certificates, so Sys-patch is required for the system to boot.
Component.Firmware.Name: Offline firmware
Component.Firmware.Desc: The system firmware itself (THZoria/NX_Firmware), extracted into out/Firmware/<firmware name>/. About 340 MB — tick it only when you really mean to update or repair the system.
Component.Conflict.SameTitle: ⚠️ Conflicts with another selected component: both install the same system module, so only one can be kept.
Component.Breeze.Desc: Breeze-Beta save editor. The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.Dbi.Desc: DBI installer. DBI.nro goes to switch/DBI/, and the translation file is picked by UI language (zhcn for Simplified, zhtw for Traditional, en otherwise) and saved as translation.bin.
Component.EdiZonOverlay.Desc: EdiZon overlay: cheats and save editing. The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.Goldleaf.Desc: Goldleaf file manager and NSP installer, placed in switch/Goldleaf/.
Component.Nxdumptool.Desc: nxdumptool: dump game cards and installed titles, placed in switch/nxdt_rw_poc/.
Component.NxShell.Desc: NX-Shell file manager, placed in switch/NX-Shell/.
Component.Ftpd.Desc: ftpd: an FTP server running on the console (sys-module build). The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.Haku33.Desc: Haku33: wipe system usage traces and logs, placed in switch/Haku33/.
Component.Jksv.Desc: JKSV: save data backup and restore, placed in switch/JKSV/.
Component.LunaApp.Desc: Luna-App: ambient lighting and peripheral control. The main archive is extracted into the out root, and enctemplate.zip is fetched from the repository file tree into config/luna/enctemplate/.
Component.SimpleModAlchemist.Desc: Simple Mod Alchemist: a sys-module to batch-enable or disable mods. The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.SysClk.Desc: sys-clk: CPU/GPU/memory clocks and fan control (sys-module). The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.SysDvr.Desc: SysDVR: stream the console screen and audio to a PC. The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.LdnMitm.Desc: ldn_mitm: a local-wireless play patch that routes local multiplayer over the network. The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.Sphaira.Desc: sphaira: a multi-purpose homebrew app (installer, file manager, save manager). The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.Fizeau.Desc: Fizeau: adjust screen colour, brightness and saturation. The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.NxActivityLog.Desc: NX-Activity-Log: play time and launch count statistics, placed in switch/NX-Activity-Log/.
Component.SwitchFirmwareDumper.Desc: Switch-Firmware-Dumper: dump the console firmware, placed in switch/Firmware-Dumper/.
Component.BatteryDesyncFix.Desc: battery_desync_fix_nx: fix a battery gauge that no longer matches the real charge, placed in switch/battery_desync_fix_nx/.
Component.SysBotbase.Desc: sys-botbase: a background sysmodule that lets automation scripts on your PC control the console over the network. Placed at the SD card root.
Component.UsbBotbase.Desc: usb-botbase: same as sys-botbase but over USB. ⚠️ Both install the same system module, so pick only one.
Component.MissionControl.Desc: MissionControl: lets third-party Bluetooth controllers (PS / Xbox, etc.) pair with the console directly. Placed at the SD card root.
Component.SysCon.Desc: sys-con: lets third-party USB / Bluetooth controllers work without injection. Placed at the SD card root.
Component.SysFtpd.Desc: sys-ftpd: a background FTP server reachable over your LAN right after boot. Placed at the SD card root.
Component.NxThemesInstaller.Desc: NXThemes Installer: installs and manages custom themes on the Switch. Goes to switch/NXThemesInstaller/. The official patch set (theme-patches' systemPatches, 20 .ips files) is fetched along with it into themes/systemPatches/ — without those patches, themes fail to apply on newer firmware.
Component.Avatool.Desc: Avatool: backs up, restores and replaces Switch user avatars. Goes to switch/Avatool/.
Component.SysTicon.Desc: sys-ticon: a background sysmodule that replaces the "now playing" icon on the home menu. Placed at the SD card root.
Component.LockpickRcm.Desc: Lockpick_RCM: dumps console keys (prod.keys / title.keys) and backs up NAND from RCM mode. Goes to bootloader/payloads/, launched from hekate's Payloads menu or a payload injector.
Component.TegraExplorer.Desc: TegraExplorer: a scriptable file manager / NAND tool. Goes to bootloader/payloads/. Commonly used to run Atmosphere firmware-update scripts and to restore a system partition deleted by mistake.
Component.Emuiibo.Desc: emuiibo: an amiibo emulator (a system module plus an Ultrahand overlay) that replaces physical amiibo figures with virtual ones. The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.Zing.Desc: Zing: an Ultrahand overlay for screenshots and video capture, letting you browse and manage captures right on the console. The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.ReverseNxRt.Desc: ReverseNX-RT: switches between docked and handheld mode on the fly (games render at docked quality while the console is still used handheld). The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.StatusMonitorOverlay.Desc: Status-Monitor-Overlay: shows live CPU/GPU/RAM clocks and usage, temperatures and frame rate on screen. The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.QuickNtp.Desc: QuickNTP: syncs the console clock over NTP in one tap (the Switch has no built-in time sync). The whole archive is extracted into the out root.
Component.KeyX.Desc: KeyX: an overlay showing the current button state and combos, useful for spotting stick drift or dead buttons. The archive is picked by UI language (KeyX-CN for Chinese, KeyX-EN otherwise) and extracted into the out root.
Component.AtmoXL.Desc: AtmoXL-Titel-Installer: installs NSP / NSZ / XCI files to the console or SD card - game dumps, updates and DLC. Extracted into the out root.
Component.Awoo.Desc: Awoo-Installer: an NSP / NSZ / XCI installer with USB and network install support (pair it with ns-usbloader on the PC). Extracted into the out root.
Component.Linkalho.Desc: linkalho: writes a one-off local account link (fully offline) so games that demand a linked account stop nagging. Chinese UI pulls the localised repo. Extracted into the out root.
Component.Dns90Tester.Desc: Switch_90DNS_tester: one-button check of whether the console's internet access is blocked - use it to confirm DNS blocking actually works. A single .nro placed in switch/Switch_90DNS_tester/.
Component.Wiliwili.Desc: wiliwili: a third-party bilibili client with gamepad support, danmaku and multi-part videos. Only wiliwili.nro is taken from the archive, placed in switch/wiliwili/.
Component.Moonlight.Desc: Moonlight-Switch: a streaming client that puts your PC's NVIDIA GameStream / Sunshine session on the console. A single .nro placed in switch/Moonlight-Switch/.
Component.TriPlayer.Desc: TriPlayer: a background music player (one sysmodule plus a Ultrahand overlay) with background playback, cover art and lyrics. Extracted into the out root.
Global.BootEntries.Hint: Determines the boot entries written into bootloader/hekate_ipl.ini; select at least one.
Global.Boot.SysNand.Desc: Runs CFW on the internal eMMC.
Global.Boot.EmuNand.Desc: Runs CFW on an emulated system; the safest option.
Global.Boot.Name: Display name
Global.Boot.Name.Hint: Name shown for this entry in the hekate menu and in this window. Leave empty to use the default name (zbxt / zspjxt / xnpjxt).
Global.Boot.Logo.Hint: Optional. Pick an image to use as this entry's hekate boot logo (logopath). It is copied into bootloader/res/ on the SD card and referenced from bootloader/hekate_ipl.ini. It must be a 32-bit (ARGB) BMP - 24-bit BMPs are not supported; 1280x720 or smaller is recommended.
Global.Boot.Icon.Hint: Optional. Pick an image to use as this entry's icon in the Nyx boot menu (icon). It is copied into bootloader/res/ on the SD card and referenced from bootloader/hekate_ipl.ini. Use BMP. If left empty, Nyx looks for bootloader/res/<entry name>.bmp and then falls back to its default icon.
Global.BlankSerial.SysNand: Blank the serial number on sysMMC (real CFW)
Global.BlankSerial.SysNand.Desc: Writes blank_prodinfo_sysmmc into exosphere.ini, hiding the console serial and calibration data on the real system. Selecting this force-enables Sys-patch (otherwise the invalid certificates prevent the system from booting).
Global.BlankSerial.EmuNand: Blank the serial number on emuMMC (virtual CFW)
Global.BlankSerial.EmuNand.Desc: Writes blank_prodinfo_emummc into exosphere.ini, hiding the console serial and calibration data on the virtual system. Selecting this force-enables Sys-patch. The two options are independent — blank whichever you want.
Global.Dns90.SysNand: Enable 90DNS on the real CFW system
Global.Dns90.SysNand.Desc: Generates default.txt and sysmmc.txt under atmosphere/hosts to block Nintendo servers and telemetry on the sysMMC, and turns on enable_dns_mitm in system_settings.ini.
Global.Dns90.EmuNand: Enable 90DNS on the virtual CFW system
Global.Dns90.EmuNand.Desc: Generates default.txt and emummc.txt under atmosphere/hosts to block Nintendo servers and telemetry on the emuMMC, and turns on enable_dns_mitm in system_settings.ini.
Global.Ram8Gb.Desc: Writes enable_mem_mode=1 into exosphere.ini and memmode=1 into each boot entry; Hekate switches to the ram8GB payload.
Global.PreferPreRelease.Desc: Use a pre-release build when one is newer than the latest stable release.
Global.AutoPackZip: Pack into a zip after generating
Global.AutoPackZip.Desc: After generating, pack the out folder into a single zip (no extra top-level folder) that you can unzip straight onto the SD card root.
Global.BootRequired: Select at least one system to boot into
Opt.Ultrahand.KeyCombo.Desc: Press these buttons together in-game to open Ultrahand. Choices come from the official default combos; the default is L+DDOWN. On first launch Ultrahand mirrors this value into the Tesla config automatically.
Opt.Ultrahand.CustomMemory.Desc: Writes custom_overlay_memory_MB into the [memory] section. Note this does not set the heap size directly — it adds a 4th step to Ultrahand's Overlay Memory slider (which normally offers only 4/6/8 MB), and you still have to select it inside Ultrahand. Only even values greater than 8 are accepted.
Opt.Ultrahand.DefaultLang.Desc: Writes default_lang in the [ultrahand] section; it decides which file under config/ultrahand/lang Ultrahand loads. By default it follows this wizard's UI language. Only en works without the language pack (English strings are compiled into ovlmenu.ovl); picking any other language enables "Install language pack" automatically, without which the setting has no effect.
Log.InvalidKeyCombo: Hotkey "{0}" is not valid (needs 2-4 valid buttons); fell back to {1}.
Log.InvalidOverlayMemory: Custom overlay memory "{0}" is not valid (only even values greater than 8 are accepted); skipped the [memory] section.
Log.InvalidDefaultLang: Ultrahand language "{0}" is not a code it recognises; fell back to {1}.
Opt.Atmosphere.disable_user_exception_ha: exosphere.ini → disable_user_exception_handlers; disabling means crashes are no longer handled gracefully.
Opt.Atmosphere.usb30_force_enabled.Desc: system_settings.ini → [usb] usb30_force_enabled; faster transfers for homebrew.
Opt.Atmosphere.enable_dns_mitm.Desc: system_settings.ini → [atmosphere] enable_dns_mitm. Off by default. Bound to the two 90DNS options: checking either one turns it on, and turning it on also checks the matching 90DNS option.
Opt.Atmosphere.enable_log_manager.Desc: system_settings.ini → [atmosphere] enable_log_manager; logs are written to the SD card.
Opt.Atmosphere.enable_external_bluetooth: Redirect Bluetooth DB to SD card
system_settings.ini → [atmosphere] enable_external_bluetooth_db; shared across sysMMC and emuMMC.
Opt.Atmosphere.applet_heap_size.Desc: system_settings.ini → [hbloader] applet_heap_size; 0 uses all available memory.
Opt.Atmosphere.nogc.Desc: stratosphere.ini → [stratosphere] nogc. Auto = let Atmosphere decide.
Opt.Atmosphere.override_key.Desc: override_config.ini → [default_config] override_key; hold this button while launching a game to open the Homebrew Menu.
Opt.Atmosphere.hbl_program_id.Desc: override_config.ini → [hbl_config] program_id, the title id of the Homebrew Menu. Must be 16 hex digits; falls back to the official default when malformed.
Opt.Atmosphere.hbl_override_any_app.Desc: override_config.ini → [hbl_config] override_any_app; true lets non-game applications open the Homebrew Menu with the hotkey.
Opt.Atmosphere.hbl_path.Desc: override_config.ini → [hbl_config] path, the SD-card-relative path of the Homebrew Menu nsp.
Opt.Atmosphere.hbl_override_key.Desc: override_config.ini → [hbl_config] override_key. Same name as the [default_config] one above, but each governs its own section.
override_config.ini → [hbl_config] override_any_app_key, used together with override_any_app.
Opt.Atmosphere.sd_card_log_output_direct: system_settings.ini → [lm] sd_card_log_output_directory, only used when SD card logging is on.
Opt.Atmosphere.enable_hbl_bis_write.Desc: system_settings.ini → [atmosphere] enable_hbl_bis_write, dangerous — keep off normally.
Opt.Atmosphere.enable_deprecated_hid_mit: system_settings.ini → [atmosphere] enable_deprecated_hid_mitm, for legacy homebrew only.
Opt.Hekate.autohosoff: Power off after RTC alarm wake
Opt.Hekate.bootprotect.Desc: hekate_ipl.ini → [config] bootprotect; blocks reading/writing bootloader from HOS.
Opt.Hekate.kip1_atmosphere_kips.Desc: Adds kip1=atmosphere/kips/* so extra kips in that folder are loaded as well (mimics fusee behaviour). If the folder is missing hekate warns but still boots fine.
Opt.Hekate.kip1patch_nosigchk.Desc: Normally not needed: hekate's official patches.ini only defines this patch for FS 1.0.0 and marks it obsolete. When booting Atmosphere via pkg3, signature checks are handled by Atmosphere itself, so enabling this may make hekate warn that the patch was not found.
Opt.Hekate.nouserexceptions.Desc: Disables user exception handlers when paired with Exosphere.
Opt.Hekate.userpmu.Desc: Allows userland access to PMU registers.
Opt.Hekate.themebg.Desc: Nyx UI background color in hex, range 0B0B0B–C7C7C7.
Opt.Hekate.themecolor.Desc: Nyx text highlight color (decimal color value).
Opt.Hekate.entries5col.Desc: Shows 5 entries per row in the Launch list instead of 4 (10 total).
Opt.Hekate.timeoffset.Desc: Clock offset used by Nyx, expressed as epoch seconds.
Opt.Hekate.timedst.Desc: Adjusts the Nyx clock automatically for daylight saving time.
Opt.Hekate.homescreen.Desc: Which screen Nyx opens with by default.
Opt.Hekate.verification.Desc: Stricter means slower: Sparse (block based, fast) or Full (sha256, 100% reliable).
Opt.Hekate.umsemmcrw.Desc: When enabled, eMMC/emuMMC mounted over UMS is writable by default.
Opt.Hekate.jcdisable.Desc: Fully disables the Joy-Con driver; only useful with third-party controllers.
Opt.Hekate.jcforceright.Desc: Forces the right Joy-Con to act as the primary mouse controller (left is the default).
Opt.Hekate.bpmpclock.Desc: Use 576/563/544/408 MHz if Nyx hangs or UMS/verification fails.
Opt.Ultrahand.InstallMode.Desc: sdout.zip is the official all-in-one package; manual mode only takes ovlmenu.ovl.
Opt.Ultrahand.InstallSysmodules.Desc: Toggles system modules and shows memory usage.
Opt.Ultrahand.InstallOvlloader.Desc: The underlying loader sysmodule; required for manual installs.
Opt.SysPatch.patch_sysmmc.Desc: config/sys-patch/config.ini → patch_sysmmc; forced to 0 when CFW on sysMMC is not selected.
Opt.SysPatch.patch_emummc.Desc: config/sys-patch/config.ini → patch_emummc; forced to 0 when CFW on emuMMC is not selected.

Check.Ok.Package3: Key file atmosphere/package3 is in place
Check.Error.MergedNothing: "Merge component files into out" is on, but nothing was merged. Check whether the download folder was cleared.
Check.Error.Package3: atmosphere/package3 is missing, so Atmosphere will not boot from this SD card. Enable "Merge component files into out" and generate again.
Check.Error.TitleConflict: The selected components install the same system module ({0}) and would overwrite each other — keep only one
Check.Warn.NoBootEntry: Hekate is selected but no boot entry is checked, so hekate_ipl.ini has nothing bootable.
Check.Warn.MergeOff: The out folder only holds config files, not the components themselves. When copying to the SD card, also copy the unpacked components from download, or enable "Merge component files into out" and generate again.
Check.Warn.PayloadsMissing: "Place payload files in their proper folders" is enabled, but these files are missing: {0}. Make sure the matching payloads are still in the download folder, or generate again.
Check.Warn.ComponentNotMerged: These selected components contributed no files to out: {0}. Their unpacked folders are probably missing or extraction failed partway - make sure the download folder is still there, or generate again.
Check.Warn.DefaultLangNoLangFile: The Ultrahand language is set to {0}, but config/ultrahand/lang/{0}.json is not in out, so Ultrahand will fall back to English. Enable "Install language pack lang.zip" and generate again, or copy the language pack to the SD card as well.
Log.SomeComponentsFailed: {0}/{1} components failed. Config generation was skipped to avoid producing an incomplete SD card layout. Check your network and retry.
Log.CancelRequested: Cancellation requested, waiting for the current step…
Log.SysPatchForced: Sys-patch was enabled automatically (serial blanking is selected)
Log.LangPackAutoEnabled: Enabled "Install language pack" automatically (the Ultrahand language is {0}, which needs config/ultrahand/lang/{0}.json)
Log.NoBootEntry: No boot entry selected; hekate_ipl.ini will not be written
Log.RateLimitHint: Anonymous GitHub API access is limited to 60 requests per hour; add a token in Settings to raise the limit.
Log.TokenMissing: No GitHub token configured, using anonymous requests
Settings.GitHubToken.Desc: Leave empty for anonymous access; anonymous is limited to 60 requests per hour.
Settings.GitHubToken.Opened: Opened GitHub's token creation page in your browser. Tick the public_repo scope (or keep the defaults), click Generate token at the bottom, then paste the result into the box above.
Settings.GitHubToken.Valid: Token is valid: signed in as {0}, {1}/{2} requests left this hour.
Settings.GitHubToken.Anonymous: No token set: using anonymous access, {0}/{1} requests left this hour.
Settings.GitHubToken.Invalid: Token is invalid (HTTP {0}). Make sure you did not copy extra spaces or line breaks.
Settings.Proxy.Desc: For example http://127.0.0.1:7890; leave empty for a direct connection.
Settings.Mirror.Desc: Host only, for example https://gh.example.com. Leave empty to use GitHub directly. When set: downloads go through it; version lookups still try GitHub first (a mirror's egress IP is shared, so unauthenticated lookups there are more likely to be rate-limited) and fall back to it only when GitHub cannot be reached. Note: a mirror is a third-party relay, so a configured Token is forwarded through it as well.
Settings.Mirror.Invalid: Bad format - enter the host only (e.g. https://gh.shubiao.cc.cd), without a repository path. GitHub is used directly for this run.
Settings.Mirror.BuildGuide.Opened: Opened the mirror setup guide in your default browser.
Settings.BootDatUrl.Desc: Leave empty to use the built-in default. Accepted forms (the first two both end up at the same raw address): (1) the web form https://github.com/owner/repo/blob/branch/path; (2) the raw form https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owner/repo/branch/path; (3) GitHub's /raw/ form. Other sites work too, but such addresses get no fallback channel. When a mirror is configured it follows the mirror as well.
Settings.BootDatUrl.Invalid: This address is unusable (a full http/https address is required). The default address will be used for this run.
Settings.UpdateUrl.Desc: Leave empty to use the built-in default. Accepts a plain owner/repo or a full https://github.com/owner/repo link (a releases page, a tag page or the API address also work). GitHub hosts only - other sites are reported as unusable and the default address is used instead.
Settings.UpdateUrl.Placeholder: e.g. owner/repo or a full link
Settings.UpdateUrl.Invalid: This address is unusable (an owner/repo name must be recognizable). The default address is used for this check instead.
Settings.Repos.Hint: Leave a box empty to use the built-in default (shown in grey). Accepts owner/name or a full https://github.com/owner/name URL. If the value cannot be parsed, the default address is used instead.
Settings.Repos.Invalid: Invalid format (expected owner/name); the default address will be used this time.
Settings.Repo.Hekate.Hint: Official hekate. Left empty: a Simplified/Traditional Chinese UI defaults to the easyworld Chinese package below, other languages use the official one. The 8 GB RAM build is the same — the Chinese package still comes from easyworld; only the __ram8GB.bin payload, which that repo does not ship, comes from the official repo.
Settings.Repo.Hekate.EasyWorld.Hint: The Nyx Chinese package from easyworld/hekate (_sc Simplified / _tc Traditional). Filling this row works too — when both rows are filled, the official row wins.
Settings.Repo.Invalid: Download source "{0}": "{1}" is not a valid owner/name, the default address will be used instead.
Settings.Repo.Reset: All download sources reset to their defaults
Settings.Slots: Plugin files (download address and file name)
Settings.Slots.Hint: Every file a plugin needs gets one row: the address on the left, the file name on the right. Leave a box empty to use the built-in default (shown as the grey placeholder). The address accepts owner/name or a full https://github.com/owner/name link; the file name may use x or * as a wildcard (e.g. write release.zip as sys-ftpd-x.zip). A few rows have a **repository folder** on the right instead (that row fetches every file inside it); those rows say so.
Settings.Slots.DirectoryHint: This row fetches **every file** inside the "{0}" folder of the repository above (subfolders excluded) and downloads them one by one.
Settings.Slots.InvalidAddress: The address "{1}" for plugin file "{0}" is not a valid owner/name, so the default address will be used this time.
Log.BootDatMissing: No usable boot.dat this time, skipped - it is no longer bundled and has to be downloaded. If you changed the address, check the boot.dat download address in advanced settings; the log above says why the download failed.
Log.BootDatFailed: boot.dat download failed ({0}); this item is skipped for this run - everything else is still produced.
Log.UpdateHandOver: New version started; closing the old one ({0})
Log.UpdateKeptRunning: The old version keeps running (the hand-over was not performed) - fix the problem above and press Check for updates again.
Update.NoRelease: This repository has no releases yet, so updates cannot be checked.
Update.NoAsset: The new release has no {0}, so it cannot be updated automatically - please download it from the releases page.
Update.NotExecutable: What was downloaded is not an executable ({0}); launching was skipped - usually an error page returned by something in the middle of the network, so check the proxy or the mirror.
Update.LaunchFailed: Could not start the new version: {0}
Update.LaunchFailedUnknown: Could not start the new version: the system returned no process handle.
Update.LaunchDied: The new version exited immediately after starting (exit code {0}). The file is at {1} - the usual cause is that the .NET 8 Desktop Runtime is not installed on this machine. The old version keeps running.

Log.BootIconMissing: Icon for entry "{0}" was not found, icon skipped: {1}
Log.BootIconCopyFailed: Failed to copy the icon for entry "{0}", icon skipped: {1}

Log.PayloadBinFallback: The localized hekate package has no standalone payload.bin; copied {0} from the package to payload.bin in the root.
Log.PayloadBinFallbackFailed: Failed to create the root payload.bin (source {0}): {1}
Log.StandardPayloadRemoveFailed: Could not remove the standard payload from the out root: {0} ({1})

Log.RepoDirectoryFetch: Listing the {1} folder of {0} — found {2} files

Log.RepoBundleFailed: Whole-repo archive fetch for {0} failed ({1}/: {2}); falling back to per-file downloads — one request per file, which can hit GitHub's unauthenticated rate limit (set a token in Advanced settings)
